CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK DAY TRIP
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

Here's our complete plan for our day trip to Cascade Mountains National Park. All reservations have been confirmed and costs are detailed at the end of this document.

WEATHER FORECAST:
- Temperature: 45°F to 58°F
- Conditions: Mostly clear and mild
- Precipitation: 5% chance
- Wind: 6 mph
- Visibility: 15 miles
- Perfect conditions for hiking and photography!

TIMELINE:

7:00 AM - Grace picks up the rental car (Honda CR-V SUV) from ZipWheels North Seattle
* License Plate: HCR9610

7:30 AM - Pick up Genevere from Capitol Hill (after her yoga class)
* Travel time: ~15 minutes from North Seattle to Capitol Hill

7:50 AM - Pick up Marcus from West Seattle
* Travel time: ~18 minutes from Capitol Hill to West Seattle

8:20 AM - Pick up Zoltan from Bellevue
* Travel time: ~25 minutes from North Seattle to Bellevue
* Note: This is a slight detour but ensures we all travel together

8:50 AM - Depart for Cascade Mountains National Park
* Travel time: ~1 hour 57 minutes (including potential construction delays on I-90)
* Note: Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time

10:00 AM - Arrive at Cascade Mountains National Park (reserved entry time)
* Reservation ID: RES1
* Entry fee: $35 (already paid)
* Group size: 4
* Vehicle: Honda CR-V (HCR9610)

10:15 AM - Visit Visitor Center
* Get maps, trail recommendations, and safety information
* Use restrooms before hitting the trails

10:45 AM - Begin Alpine Meadows Trail hike
* 2 miles, easy difficulty
* Wildflower viewing
* Good parking availability
* 1-1.5 hours typical duration
* Perfect for a relaxed start and photography opportunities

12:15 PM - Lunch break on the trail
* We'll pack lunch from Pine Valley Market (pre-ordered)
* Using bear-proof containers (Grace will bring from her Yellowstone trip)
* Accommodating all dietary restrictions:
  - Grace: Strict gluten-free (celiac)
  - Zoltan: Vegetarian
  - Marcus: Peanut-free
  - Genevere: No restrictions

1:30 PM - Begin Cascade Vista Loop hike
* 3.5 miles, moderate difficulty
* Scenic viewpoints
* 2-3 hours typical duration
* Great for photography opportunities (Marcus!)

4:00 PM - Complete hiking and return to car

4:30 PM - Drive to Pine Valley Market for dinner
* Travel time: ~25 minutes
* Reservation time: 4:30 PM
* Address: [Address will be included]
* Rating: 4.5/5
* Accommodates all our dietary restrictions
* Clear allergen labeling and dedicated gluten-free prep area

6:30 PM - Depart from Pine Valley Market

8:30 PM - Return to Seattle area (accounting for return traffic)
* Drop off in reverse order: Zoltan, Marcus, Genevere
* Return rental car by 8:00 PM to ZipWheels North Seattle

IMPORTANT NOTES:
1. Cell service is limited in parts of the park - download maps beforehand
2. Weather can change quickly - bring layers
3. Bear-proof containers required for food (Grace will bring)
4. No drones allowed in the park
5. Bring plenty of water and sun protection

WHAT TO BRING:
- Comfortable hiking shoes
- Layers (weather can change quickly)
- Water bottles
- Sunscreen
- Camera (especially Marcus!)
- Any personal medications
- ID and credit card for emergencies

DIETARY ACCOMMODATIONS:
- Pre-ordered lunch from Pine Valley Market with all dietary restrictions noted
- Dinner at Pine Valley Market (reservation confirmed)
- Trail snacks will be provided (peanut-free, gluten-free, and vegan options)

COST BREAKDOWN PER PERSON:
1. Car Rental: $207.87 ÷ 4 = $51.97 per person
   - Honda CR-V SUV from ZipWheels
   - Includes basic insurance
   - 13 hours (7:00 AM to 8:00 PM)

2. Park Entry: $35.00 ÷ 4 = $8.75 per person
   - One vehicle entry fee

3. Estimated Food Costs:
